reason: My customers phone us and the front desk already handles calls. I can't see why I'd pay $19 or $49 a month for a chat box that the website is only an afterthought for.
objection: A chatbot answering on my site when people would rather phone, and it booking appointments without a human checking them first.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from a clinic like mine that the chat books appointments my front desk would otherwise miss.
